notizie.titolo: EDPB and DPAs from countries and organisation with EU adequacy decision take stock of progress and set 2027 priorities
notizie.descrizione: Brussels, 19 November - The EDPB met on 17 November with Commissioners and representatives of the Data Protection Authorities (DPAs) from the countries and the international organisation with an EU adequacy decision. This gathering marked the third of its kind, following the first one in October 2024 and the second one in December 2025 . The meeting was an opportunity to discuss the joint activities carried out in 2026 and identify the way forward for 2027. “The authorities in this network are essential partners for the EDPB: together we can advance privacy and data protection on a global scale. notizie.titolo: EDPB supports use of other models of contractual clauses for onward transfers of personal data
notizie.descrizione: Brussels 13 November – At its latest plenary, the EDPB adopted a statement on the use of other models of contractual clauses for onward transfers of personal data * . The statement welcomes recent updates made by the European Commission on its FAQs on the EU Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) **, recognising that the Model Contractual Clauses (MCCs) developed by the Council of Europe (CoE MCC) and the ones developed by the Ibero-American Data Protection Network (RIPD MCC) may also be used for onward transfers of personal data received under the EU SCCs.
